notes: This was close between Action and Simulation: the author calls it a free-for-all physics playground, which is Simulation's Physics Sim, but the thing you actually do is ragdoll other players with a sword and a rocket launcher in a shared clash space, so Action leads and Simulation is named second to carry physics-rig — the ramps and ragdoll props whose reactions are the entertainment. Since a town of streets and blocky buildings is not Action's flat tripping-free arena floor, I went outside the genre's typical shapes to settlement-static from the catalogue: a fixed pre-built town with nothing to claim or own, which routes P0 and keeps the build on the proven pipeline. Battlegrounds survives the shape swap because I kept most of it — anti-camp spawn placement and sightline breakers bent to blocky buildings and street props — and dropped only hazard-kill, since nothing asked for ring-out pits around the town. With no user to ask I left the buildings as facades, so no interiors and no P3, and did not add destructible-cluster despite the rocket launcher because breakable architecture was never requested; the author's answers already fixed the rest — cartoon blocky, a few streets crossable in seconds, and no win condition to place.
